Liquidity: Why Price Can Move Fast Around Key Areas

Liquidity describes how easily buying and selling can happen without a large price impact. When liquidity is thinner or many orders interact around the same area, price can move quickly and slippage can become more relevant. Treat liquidity as a market condition to understand, not as a magic signal that tells you what happens next.
